purpose: One fixed retrospective check on the already-seen 47 Bybit Spot 4h MR40 pairs to catch broken net-PNL, stop-touch or floating equity geometry BEFORE any genuinely future forward-day assessment; it must NOT be used to choose the 2x multiple or promote a stop.

stop.measure: Arithmetic mean of latest 14 completed 4h true ranges based on previous close, computed at signal close, no future entry bar
stop.gap_rule: open below stop => hypothetical exit at bar Open; else Low crosses stop => hypothetical exit at stop; never assume actual fill

metrics: Net compounded terminal equity USDT and PNL; worst modeled in-position equity drawdown from prior peak if highs occur before lows (NOT verified path); stop event count and gaps, average holding hours, survival time versus baseline
forbidden: No tuning, choosing multiple, or rerunning new grid after reading historical outcomes
No promotion or strategy runtime modifications
No actual fill inference from OHLC lows
No claim that 2025-2026 is genuinely unseen to project
